picks.editorial_note: MIT's Barzilay and Collins won the prestigious Pritzker Prize for pioneering AI-enabled antibiotic discovery, a landmark recognition of deep learning's real-world impact on combating drug-resistant infections.
picks.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery

picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's pledge of up to $100B in equity to the public, alongside SpaceX's giveaways, raises major policy questions about how AI windfall wealth should be distributed to society.
picks.title: Billions in SpaceX, Anthropic Stock Pledged to the Public. Who Benefits? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: Nebraska-Lincoln will lead cybersecurity for FabAID, a $24.5M NSF-funded national cyberinfrastructure project for AI-driven science led by the Morgridge Institute, a significant multi-institution investment.
picks.title: University to lead cybersecurity for national Fabric for AI-Driven Science project

picks.editorial_note: HKUST and HSBC signed a strategic framework to launch HSBC's new AI & Emerging Technology Institute, deepening a major academic-industry partnership in financial AI innovation.
picks.title: HKUST and HSBC Forge Strategic Partnership to Advance AI, Emerging Technologies and Financial Innovation
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: Boston University joined a $39.5M ARPA-H consortium with Philips, Johns Hopkins, and Weill Cornell to develop AI-enabled robotic catheter technology for remote stroke surgery, a notable cross-sector health-tech partnership.
picks.title: Brink Bites: Robotic Stroke Surgery, Curbing Junk Food Sales, and American Attitudes On Data Center Construction

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge researchers used an AI-guided design technique to create a broad-spectrum bird flu vaccine with complete protection against diverse variants in animal trials, a significant scientific advance for pandemic preparedness.
picks.title: Scientists are using AI to develop superior vaccines against viruses threatening global health

picks.editorial_note: A Case Western-led, NIH-funded multi-institutional team will use AI, satellite imaging, and large-scale health data to study environmental drivers of Alzheimer's and dementia, a substantial funded research effort.
picks.title: Case Western Reserve-led team to study how the environment contributes to Alzheimer’s and dementia | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: Tel Aviv University and Stanford researchers showed AI models can learn general predictive skills purely from self-generated synthetic data, a notable fundamental advance in how AI systems can be trained.
picks.title: AI Learns to Predict the World Without Ever Seeing It

picks.editorial_note: ANU received Google.org funding to modernize fusion simulation software with AI, accelerating clean energy research through a notable industry-academia funding partnership.
picks.title: ANU receives Google funding to boost fusion energy research with AI

picks.editorial_note: ASU's $3.2M NIH-funded project uses deep learning on retinal photographs and blood biomarkers to screen for preclinical Alzheimer's, a promising low-cost early-detection approach.
picks.title: What the eye may reveal about Alzheimer’s
